properties.name: Main Line North (Manila Tutuban – Dagupan – San Fernando, La Union)
properties.operator_wwii: Imperial Japanese Army Riku'un Kanrikyoku (1942–1945); US Army Luzon Military Railway (1945)
properties.wartime_notes: Seized Jan 1, 1942 after USAFFE demolitions. Used for April 1942 Bataan Death March POW rail transfers (San Fernando, Pampanga to Capas, Tarlac). Reopened to San Fernando, La Union on July 21, 1942. Heavily bombed and bridges demolished in Jan–Feb 1945; restored by US Army 775th/790th Railway Operating Battalions as the Luzon Military Railway.

properties.name: Main Line South (Manila Tutuban – Calamba – Lucena – Naga – Legazpi)
properties.operator_wwii: Imperial Japanese Army Riku'un Kanrikyoku (1942–1945); US Army Luzon Military Railway (1945)
properties.wartime_notes: Unified Manila–Legazpi corridor completed May 1938. Severely damaged during 1941–42 campaign; last main line reopened by Japanese (March 1943). Heavily bombed by Allied air forces and sabotaged by guerrillas in 1944–45; extensive post-war rehabilitation required.
